initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people. I prefer properties near public transport.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people. I prefer properties near public transport.
